transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

I... well, I suppose I came in because... even when I'm feeling a bit better, I just can't shake this feeling. It's... it's about some of the people at church. And my walking club. I just... I think they're watching me. And sometimes I feel like they're putting little messages about me in the church bulletin, or... or in the things they say when I'm around.
Do you ever feel like your thoughts are being placed in your mind by someone else, or that someone else can control what you're thinking?
No... I don't think so. My thoughts are... they're just mine. I haven't noticed anything like that.
When you say people are putting messages in the church bulletin or changing what they say around you, do you feel like these messages are specifically about you or meant for you personally?

Well... yes. Like I was saying before... even on my better days, I just can't seem to shake the feeling that they're watching me. The little things in the bulletin... they just seem like they're about me. I don't really know what else to say about it, but... yes. That's how it feels.
Do you feel like certain events, actions, or even things you see or hear in the media are directed at you personally, even if others might not notice that connection?

I don't... I don't really watch much television, if that's what you mean. I don't know about the news or anything like that. It's just... well, like I already said. It's the people at the church, and my walking club. Even when I'm having a good day, I just can't shake the feeling that they're watching me, and... putting those little messages in the bulletin. I don't really have much else to say about it.
Do you ever feel like random events, comments, or actions from people you don't know are directed at you or have a special meaning for you personally?
No... not really. I don't... I don't pay much attention to strangers. It's just the people I already told you about. I haven't noticed anything from people I don't know.
Do you ever feel that things people say or do in your daily life, outside of church and your walking club, have a special meaning for you or are directed at you?
No, not really. It's... just the things I mentioned before. I just stay home mostly, so... no.

Have you ever felt that things happening in your immediate surroundings, like objects being moved or small changes in your house, were related to you or part of what the people at church or your walking club are doing?

No... nothing like that. Nobody is moving my things. I... I think I already explained why I came in. It's just... even on my better days, I just can't shake that feeling that those people at church and the club are watching me. And the little messages... in the bulletin, or just in what they say. I don't know anything about things moving in my house.
Do these feelings about people at church and your walking club ever extend to other groups or people in your life, or does it stay focused only on those specific groups?
No, it's... it's just them. Just the church and the club. I don't really see anyone else anyway.
Do you ever question whether these feelings about people watching you and sending messages are actually true, or do you feel certain that they are happening even if others might not believe you?

I... I don't really know what other people believe. But like I just said... that's the whole reason I came in. Because even on my better days, I just can't shake the feeling. I know they're watching me. The messages in the bulletin, the things they say... I just know it's happening. I don't really question it.
